issue.title: Project awaits artifact links for agent-to-agent waits (%wait:<agent>)
issue.description: Project an artifact link for agent-to-agent waits. An agent launched with `%wait:<agent>` (or `%wait(<agent>)`) is published as a hood-snapshot `wait` relationship but produces no artifact link, unlike `%wait(bead=<id>)`, which since epic sase-17o projects `agent:<name> awaits bead:<id>` via the `agent-wait-bead` rule (src/sase/artifact_links/projection/_agent_wait_bead.py). Extend the projection-only `awaits`/`awaited-by` relation (sase-core crates/sase_core/src/artifact_link/relation.rs; recommended target kinds are currently ["bead"]) to accept `agent` targets, publish the waited-on agent names as portable metadata (or derive them from published hood snapshots), and add a projection rule emitting `agent:<waiter> awaits agent:<waited>`. The relation was deliberately named `awaits` so it can take agent targets. Proposed by phase bead sase-17o.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1).

Agent waits need a different metadata source (hood-snapshot wait relationships or a new portable field) plus a sase-core recommended-kinds change, so it is a separate, cross-repo feature.
